biggest_gap.title: No clean-clone verify passes every test: on a quiet machine the G1 list-volume gate's answers from /api/audit/log at demo volume fail
biggest_gap.detail: The piece itself now does its job. It beats Odoo on add-a-custom-field-and-filter on every metric, round 1's print/export gap is fixed, and my own isolation and permission attacks found nothing. But the round has no full passing verify, so the piece cannot be counted done. On a mostly quiet machine (run 3), G1ListVolumeTests.Every_list_answers_each_tenant_from_its_own_rows_at_demo_volume failed: 29 list answers of /api/audit/log (about 400,000 audit rows per tenant) were not 200. They were deep skips on sort=occurredAt, groupBy=actorKind, record contains 'q', and many filters 'fields eq <column>'. The same test passed in run 2. A similar failure is already recorded for p12 r4's integrator run (8 answers of /api/audit/log with a fields filter). The list path for that filter is the kernel ListBinding multi-value choice filter, which p09 changed in a6bcedcd (array overlap for the GIN index). So p07 (audit log) and p09 (kernel list filter) share it. The two busier runs each failed a different load-sensitive test of another piece (clientIsolation.test.tsx timeouts, compare 'control C3'). The audit-log one is the only failure seen on a quiet machine. For a UAE trader the user-facing effect is that filtering or paging deep into the audit log at real volume can fail. For the round, it blocks the piece.
biggest_gap.evidence: verify-run3/dotnet-suite.log.gz from line 1217 (the list of the 29 requests); verify-run3/verify-load-samples (peak 35.8); run 2 passed the same test (verify-run2/verify-critic-p09-custom-fields-r2-run2.log.gz, '== suite: passed'). To reproduce, run ./erp verify, or only the dotnet gate project with --filter FullyQualifiedName~G1ListVolumeTests, on a clean clone of bf50d503, then read the 'list answers at volume that are not the asking tenant's own' message.

other_findings: Select default lost on creation (p09 screen): adding a single-select field on the Custom fields screen and choosing its 'Default for new records' in the same save silently drops the default. The screen sends POST {..., "default": null, options:[{value:null,labelEn:'MSC'},{value:null,labelEn:'Maersk'}]} although the select shows Maersk, and the field is saved without a default (reproduced three times: Incoterm/FOB, Payment terms/Net 30, Shipping line two/Maersk). Choosing the default afterwards on the saved field works, and the API accepts a default by label at creation ("Air" becomes air). ui/select-default-on-create.txt, ui/ui4.mjs.
Option values made from upper-case labels read oddly: EXW becomes eXW, FOB fOB, CIF cIF, MSC mSC. An API filter must spell cfIncoterm eq 'fOB' ('cif' gives 400). api/r1gaps-out.txt.

A descending sort by a custom field puts the records without a value first. sort=-cfInsuranceCover shows blanks on the first pages of 100,008 contacts, so 'highest first' is not usable from the column menu. api/r1gaps-out.txt.
Group by a custom field works only for single select and yes/no. Text, number and date answer 400 list.notGroupable.
Alt+Shift+F (list the records holding this value) did nothing right after the History panel was opened on the record (Arabic run). Without the panel it works in both languages (ui/ui-results.txt).

Fixed since round 1 and still fixed: list print and export with custom columns and custom-field filters (CSV, Excel and PDF, English and Arabic: 18 rows and header 'Insurance cover'/'التغطية التأمينية'); 2-decimal display (5,000.56, history 'Insurance cover: from 5,000.56 to 1,234.56'); the audit trail names custom fields by label in both languages; required enforced on every save (an existing record saved without the key gets the default, an explicit null gives 400); select default by label through the API; a label equal to a built-in field's English or Arabic label refused; Arabic 'سجل مرتبط' for lookup and a 'سنة-شهر-يوم' date placeholder.
Performance holds: sort or group by a custom field over 100,007 contacts answered in 1.3 to 1.8 s at load 60 to 70 (api/timing-out.txt); a custom-number filter answered at once in the browser.

The API document describes custom fields generically. ContactRow and ContactDto carry customFields and customFieldDefinitions and point to GET /api/customfields/fields for the workspace's keys; a newly added field (cfInsuranceCover) is not named in /api/openapi/v1.json.

Not judged: import (no contact import exists yet; it depends on p14). The money rule: a number custom field has no currency, rate or base amount, so a money custom field cannot meet CLAUDE.md rule 2 (unchanged since round 1).
